title: Unity Square — Night
intro:
A man steps out of the metro mouth and catches your eye.

"Hey — tourist? Please. I just need a few euros for the night bus. My card died. I can get home if I make the last one."
ask: He waits, too close, palms half open.

clues: He glances twice toward the dark alley behind the kiosk.
He says he forgot his wallet — then says it again, word for word.

give_money.result:
You dig out a note. His smile hardens.

A second shape peels from the alley. Something cold presses under your ribs.

You never hear the bus arrive.

help.text: Walk him to the bus stop
help.result:
You offer to walk him over. He thanks you, steers you past the fountain — into shadow.

The knife is already out.

Unity Square keeps its night schedule without you.

call_police.result:
You raise your phone. His face empties.

He bolts into the alley before the line connects. Sirens somewhere, later.

You are alone again. Alive. Hands shaking.

walk_away.result:
You shake your head and turn.

He curses in a language you almost recognize. Footsteps follow for half a block, then stop.

You do not look back until the hotel lights.

clues: His hands tremble; the exhaustion looks real, not performed.
A crumpled day-ticket stub sticks from his jacket — today's date, stamped.

give_money.result:
He takes the note with both hands, almost laughing with relief.

"Thank you. Really. Get home safe."

He jogs toward the stop. For a moment the square feels less sharp.

help.text: Walk him to the bus stop
help.result:
You walk him to the illuminated stop. He talks about missing the last train from Piraeus.

The night bus sighs open. He waves once from the steps.

You head back across the square feeling foolish — and safer.

call_police.result:
Blue lights. Questions. His voice cracks while he repeats himself.

They take him aside. Nobody thanks you.

Later you wonder whether fear chose for you.

walk_away.result:
You mutter an apology and keep moving.

He stays under the metro sign, smaller somehow.

Sleep comes late. The square stays in your ears.
